content.text:
Not quite. The collision chain now works: ball1 hits ball2, and ball2 hits ball3. Ball3 reaches the cup’s ramp, but slows before fully entering, rolls backward, and repeatedly bumps ball2. All three finish outside the cup.

The correction below removes the ramp and makes the cup’s interior bottom flush with the floor, eliminating the climb that stopped ball3. This revision has not been re-simulated here.
